title: Fix RecipesFolderStore .withSecurityScope iOS unavailability
description: RecipesFolderStore.swift uses URL.BookmarkCreationOptions.withSecurityScope and URL.BookmarkResolutionOptions.withSecurityScope which are unavailable on iOS (macOS-only). Replace with the correct iOS equivalents or remove the option flags. Lines 31 and 59 of CookbookApp/Recipes/RecipesFolderStore.swift.
acceptance_criteria: Build succeeds for iOS Simulator target without withSecurityScope errors
Bookmark save and resolution still function correctly on iOS

handoff_summary.completed: Both withSecurityScope option flags removed from resolveBookmark (line 32) and saveBookmark (line 60). startAccessingSecurityScopedResource() added to resolveBookmark after URL resolution. File already in correct iOS-compatible state as of commit c0c287f.
handoff_summary.risks: None. Changes were already merged into the feature branch by a sibling bead.
handoff_summary.next_action: Proceed to tester agent for iOS Simulator build verification.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: None — fix is already committed and no other bead claims this file.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: iOS bookmark API does not support .withSecurityScope; bare options: [] with startAccessingSecurityScopedResource() is the correct iOS pattern.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: Tester should verify iOS Simulator build succeeds and that bookmark save/resolve round-trip works correctly.
